ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The diagram shows a closed circuit with a solenoid wound around an iron core at the top. The original current I is marked on the left side of the circuit with an upward arrow entering the coil. At the bottom there is a power supply, and on the lower right there is a sliding rheostat with sliding contact A. The circuit connection from the rheostat goes upward toward point B near the coil. Reasoning: In this rheostat connection, moving sliding contact A to the left shortens the effective resistance segment in series with the circuit, so the total resistance decreases. With the same power supply, the current through the solenoid increases in the original direction I. By Lenz's law/self-induction, the induced electromotive force opposes the increase of the original current, so it points opposite to I.

method.method_draft: First describe the circuit in the image: identify the coil with iron core, the battery, the current direction I, and the rheostat connection through slider A. Determine which movement of A changes the series resistance: moving A left shortens the effective resistor segment, so the total resistance decreases. With the same power supply, the circuit current through the solenoid increases. Since dI/dt is positive in the original-current direction, the self-induced emf must oppose this increase, i.e. point opposite to I. Therefore choose the change: move sliding contact A to the left.

method.method_draft: Begin by describing the image: a coil on an iron core is powered through a sliding rheostat, with the original current I labeled. Since current I in the solenoid creates a magnetic flux in the core, an induced emf opposite to I would drive a current whose magnetic effect opposes the original flux. By Lenz's law this happens when the original flux is increasing, which requires the solenoid current to increase. Inspect the rheostat wiring: moving A left shortens the active resistance segment, decreases total resistance, and thus increases the current and flux. Hence the required operation is to move sliding contact A to the left.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中是一个闭合电路，上方有绕在铁芯上的螺线管，左侧导线旁标有原电流 I，箭头向上；下方有电源；右下方是滑动变阻器，滑片标为 A，滑片通过导线接到螺线管右侧附近，变阻器左端接在电源回路中。因此滑动变阻器实际接入电路的是从左端到滑片 A 之间的电阻段。推理：原电流 I 通过螺线管会在铁芯中产生磁通。若要线圈中的感应电动势方向与原电流 I 相反，根据楞次定律，感应电动势所对应的感应电流应阻碍原磁通的增加；这发生在原电流、原磁通正在增大时。要使原电流增大，需要减小电路总电阻。由图中滑动变阻器的接法可见，滑片 A 向左移动会缩短接入电路的电阻丝长度，使接入电阻减小，电流增大，磁通增大，所以感应电动势方向与原电流 I 相反。
